Name: Clint Reforged - Anthro Characters Continued Furry Patch
Author: ImRikun
Description:
This mod replaces the sprites and portraits of Clint Reforged with Panda Clint from Anthro Characters Continued. This includes the option for different beard styles, as well as seasonal clothing. I had a lot of fun drawing the clothes, felt like I was playing dressup with my blorbo.

[color=#ffff00][size=4]Installation instructions:[/size][/color]

1. Install Clint Reforged and all it's dependencies.

2. Download this mod and extract it, there should be 3 folders called "Characters", "Loose Sprites" & "Portraits"

3. Open up your mods folder then go into the "[CP] Clint Reforged" folder, drag the 3 folders into this directory.

4. It should ask if you want to replace some files, click yes to all.

5. Using Anthro Characters Continued? Might want to read the important info section below!

6. That's all folks, great job, proud of u!

[color=#ffff00][size=4]Important info! [/size][/color]

If you're using Anthro Characters Continued, you should ALSO download the "base.json" file.
This file goes in Mods > AnthroCharactersContinued > assets > AnthroConfig (replace the base.json in this folder, with the one from this mod's download page.)

The reason for doing this is because both Clint Reforged and AnthroCharactersContinued edit Clint's sprites, which could cause issues depending on the mod load order. My version of the base.json file removes the code that changes Clint's sprites, meaning it won't clash with Clint Reforged. There's most definitely an easier way to do this, but my brain is smooth and code is scawy.

If you're using the Anthro Characters Continued option to change bachelorettes to male (turning Emily to Emil), download the optional zip file and replace the default.json file in Mods > [CP] Clint Reforged > I18N with the one from the zip you downloaded.


[color=#ffff00][size=5]Other equally as important info![/size][/color]

Clint Reforged is still in development, so some sprites are either not done, or may not load in all cases (mostly his winter sprites from what I've seen?). If you don't like the idea of Clint randomly switching between being anthro and human, then don't do the base.json replacement above, if I can be honest I've barely tested this.
